content.text:
I fixed the about page on phones. The cause was a leftover rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`, which set the "How it started" section to two columns (`1fr 480px`). It came after the phone-size rule that makes that section a single column, so it overrode it. The 480px photo then pushed the page to 620px wide on a 390px screen. I removed the leftover rule.

The full Playwright suite passes (28 of 28). That includes the phone screenshot comparison for the about page, which was the one failing before. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
